description: Department of Census & Statistics - Notify the Consumer Price Index for the month of February, 2018 as 123.7
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the National Consumer Price Index figure for February 2018, published by the Department of Census and Statistics. It does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) and does not fit any specialized categories (land, legal, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial). The content is purely statistical information about economic indicators, which falls under general administrative matters not covered by the other categories.
